declared_cases.note: Serious = at least one section carries a maximum sentence of 5+ years. Three cases qualify: Cr No. 98/2023 (Nandyal Taluk PS, IPC 324/307/120B - attempt to murder); Cr No. 6/2021 (Boyinapalle PS, Hyderabad, IPC 302/395/467/468/471/420 among others - murder, dacoity, forgery of valuable security, cheating); and Cr No. 72/2020 (Chinna Chowk PS, Kadapa, IPC 120B/115/302/34 - murder). The remaining nine cases involve lesser public-order, CrPC 151 preventive, or election-conduct sections that do not carry a 5+ year maximum. All show 'Charges Framed: No' and zero convictions.
